== Notes ==
* Bleeding will be applied first when using a skill; this means it will trigger the conditional effects of skills such as [[Oppressive Gaze]], [[Vile Miasma]], and [[Necrosis]].
* Works well with [[Angorodon's Gaze]] and [[Ulcerous Lungs]].
* Has no [[duration]] (this is one of the few [[Upkeep#Skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep|skills that last indefinitely without an upkeep]]).
{{anomaly|Even though it has no [[activation time]], this signet (similar to [[Dolyak Signet]]) cannot be used while knocked down or performing an [[action]].}}
{{anomaly|After being [[resurrected]], if the player uses the skill in the middle of the stand up animation they will not begin bleeding.}}

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[{{PAGENAME}}/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
** This skill's current functionality previously belonged to [[Barbed Signet (PvP)]].
** Prior to the [[Feedback:Game updates/20101209|March 18, 2011 update]], this skill belonged to [[Curses]].
